name: CROC11_ST_IDLE
meaning: Random idle anims 4/5/6 every 0..5 s. Plays the one-time cine when the Wolf enters ACTIVATIONBOX. Queries curBox and scans when anything besides itself is inside.

name: CROC11_ST_CINE
meaning: Cine_Start(CINE, CINEFLAG, CINEBOX, CINESHEEPBOX, CINETEXT string). Waits for g_cinePlayer.finished, then state 0 and cinePlayed = 1.

name: CROC11_ST_SCAN
meaning: One-frame classification of boxObjects: Wolf -> 3, CannonBall -> 4, else 0.

name: CROC11_ST_THREATEN_WOLF
meaning: Faces the Wolf (anim 0 turn then a snap, anim 5). MSG_KILL arg 10 + anim 8 every frame while the Wolf's origin is in biteBox. Back to 0 when he dies or leaves curBox.

name: CROC11_ST_WATCH_BALL
meaning: CannonBall in curBox: takes the camera (ball msg 0x3387 arg 0, own CAMERA every frame), anim 6. When the ball leaves curBox, picks a random other box -> 5.

name: CROC11_ST_RELOCATE
meaning: Wolf frozen (MSG_FREEZE). Turns from Daffy toward the new box (anim 10/11), walks there (anim 3, 430 u/s), turns back to Daffy. Then MSG_UNFREEZE, releases the camera, -> 0.

name: CROC11_ST_DEAD
meaning: MSG_KILL from a CannonBall. Anim 2; the camera is released at its end. The corpse bounces a live Wolf dropping into biteBox (MSG_BOUNCE 0x4B, anim 9). Kept through Reset.
